tasksNotApplicable.build: Consumed as TypeScript source across the workspace (main points at src/index.ts); the consuming package's Vitest/Vite pipeline compiles it, so there is no build output of its own.
tasksNotApplicable.test: Has no test files of its own, and a bare `vitest run` exits 1 with 'No test files found'. The preset is exercised end-to-end by @pineappleui/tokens, whose vitest.config.ts calls definePineappleVitest() and whose test task fails if this preset is broken.
